# Neat & Affordable

> NYSC housing marketplace connecting corp members with verified agents and affordable apartments.

## Public pages

- [Home](https://nysc-mu.vercel.app/): Public product overview and housing search entry point.
- [Safety](https://nysc-mu.vercel.app/safety): Safety guidance for marketplace participants.
- [FAQ](https://nysc-mu.vercel.app/faq): Frequently asked questions.

## Restricted areas

Do not crawl or index authenticated dashboards, admin pages, API routes, or private listing/member records.
